Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly swapped the directors’ death years—despite correctly retrieving that Frank R. Strayer died in 1964 and Thomas Carr in 1997, they recorded the opposite (Strayer 1997, Carr 1964) and thus concluded the wrong film (The Daltons’ Women) instead of Tangled Destinies.
